destination_profile.context: Although renowned for its golden beaches, in Negombo, sightseeing opportunities are also plentiful. Predominantly Roman Catholic, it’s referred to as “Little Rome'' due to the many ornate Catholic churches. However, Buddhist, Hindu and Muslim landmarks of significance are also found - often almost next to each other. Several relics that date back to the Dutch and Portuguese colonial era remain, like the ancient Dutch Fort gate built in 1672. The 100 km long Dutch Canal is still in use, and a boat ride will offer a whole different view of Negombo and the suburbs.
